question.text: Vindhya Event-Driven Fund (a NORMAL Category III AIF, NOT a Large Value Fund) wants to run an Activist/Special-Situations play. What is the maximum percentage of Investable Funds (or NAV) it can commit to ONE investee company under SEBI AIF concentration limits?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 10.1.4.1, a regular Category III AIF cannot invest more than 10% of its Investable Funds or NAV in a single investee company. Large Value Funds enjoy a relaxed 20% cap. The Trap: Option C (20%) is the LVF relaxation — a real rule but only for Large Value Funds. Option B (25%) belongs to a different fund-category framework, not regular Cat III. Option A is a fabricated lower cap. Note: Per the source, a regular Cat III AIF cannot invest more than 10% of its Investable Funds or NAV in a single investee company; the limit is measured against Investable Funds or NAV as set out in the SEBI AIF investment-condition rules.
